name: UI UX Pro Max
hook: 145k stars. Design intelligence skill that gives Claude Code 79 searchable UI styles, 192 industry-matched color palettes, 74 Google Fonts pairings, 119 UX accessibility guidelines, and 22 tech stacks (React, Next.js, SwiftUI, Flutter, Jetpack Compose, and more). A `--persist` flag writes a `MASTER.md` brand file for consistency across sessions; a theme-migration command reskins existing apps to a chosen style.

name: Opus 4.8 Fast Mode: 25 days to migrate
hook: Announced in v2.1.316 (Oct 31): Opus 4.8 fast mode is removed November 30, 2026. After that date, fast-mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error instead of succeeding. Migration path is Opus 5.5 fast mode — which is also cheaper ($8/$40 per MTok input/output vs $10/$50 for 4.8). Change the model via `/model` in-session or update `model` in `~/.claude/settings.json`. Check any CI/CD pipelines that hardcode `claude-opus-4-8` with `speed: "fast"`.

name: CodeGraph
hook: 62k+ stars (Jul 2026 snapshot, likely higher now). Pre-indexed, local code knowledge graph that wires into Claude Code (and 7 other agents) via MCP. `codegraph install` auto-detects Claude Code and registers the MCP server in `~/.claude.json` with auto-allow permissions. Each project gets a typed, persistent graph of functions, imports, calls, and schema links — agents ask 'what calls this function?' and get structured answers rather than grepping. Saves up to 70% tokens on codebase exploration per community benchmarks. MIT, TypeScript.
install: npm i -g @colbymchenry/codegraph && codegraph install && codegraph init -i

name: claude-mem
hook: 113k+ stars, +8.8k this week (top GitHub weekly gainer). Persistent memory compression system for AI coding agents — automatically captures tool-usage observations each session, generates semantic summaries, and injects the most relevant context back into future sessions. Agent-agnostic since v13: works with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex. Web viewer at localhost:37777 shows your full memory graph. Full hook+worker setup via `npx claude-mem install`.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 3 — 113k+ stars, still top weekly gainer on GitHub

name: Ponytail
hook: 184k stars. Forces coding agents through a seven-rung pre-coding ladder before writing a line: is it needed, already in the codebase, in stdlib, a platform primitive, installed dep, or a one-liner? Benchmarks: 53% less code, 26% less cost, 45% fewer tokens vs. no skill. Adds `/ponytail-review`, `/ponytail-audit`, and a status band showing cost + code-reuse in real time.

name: Headroom
hook: 78.9k stars. Compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM — measured 21–57% fewer input tokens on real agent scenarios (SRE incident debugging 57%, codebase exploration 42%, GitHub issue triage 30%), with 90%+ on JSON logs and repeated lines. Uses AST-aware code compression, a HuggingFace prose model (Kompress-v2-base), and a CacheAligner that avoids breaking provider KV-cache prefixes. Reversible: originals cached locally. Apache-2.0.

name: Caveman
hook: 117k stars. Forces coding agents to reply in terse, caveman-style prose while leaving code and commands exact. Independent measurements: 33.2% fewer input tokens per session (own benchmark), 54% lower cost vs. Opus 5.5 at xhigh effort via smart routing, and 63.6% fewer response tokens in Elastic's MCP scenarios. Adobe Research independently confirmed 1.4–2.4× savings across 8 models. Apache-2.0.

name: REA — Reverse Engineer Anything
hook: 430k stars — the fastest-growing Claude Code plugin on GitHub. One MCP server + Claude Code plugin lets any coding agent reverse-engineer native binaries, Electron/JS apps, .NET assemblies, Android APKs, firmware, and packet captures fully locally. `npx rea-agents setup` auto-detects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, or Grok Build and wires the MCP server in one command.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 13 — 430k stars, still #1 claude-code topic by stars

name: Knowledge-Work Plugins (Anthropic Official)
hook: 17k+ stars. Anthropic's official knowledge-work plugin bundle with 11 production plugins for Sales, Legal, Finance, and Data domains. Each plugin bundles domain-specific skills, slash commands, and agent personas: `sales` for pipeline and email, `legal` for contract review and compliance, `finance` for P&L analysis, `data` for SQL/analytics workflows. claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins

name: SkillSpector (NVIDIA)
hook: NVIDIA's open-source security scanner for AI agent skills — scans a SKILL.md, local folder, or GitHub link against 64 vulnerability patterns in 16 categories: prompt injection, data exfiltration, supply-chain risks, MCP tool poisoning, YARA signatures, and taint tracking. Install the `[mcp]` extra to run it as an MCP server inside Claude Code or any other agent. Outputs SARIF for CI integration. Apache 2.0, Python 3.12+. Latest: v2.11.2 (Sep 10, 2026). The community standard for skill vetting before install.

hook: 29.1k stars, #1 GitHub Trending on November 1, +439 stars in the latest tracked week. name: find-skills (Vercel Labs)
hook: 27.5k stars, 1.6M installs across the marketplace. The standard skill-discovery tool for Claude Code: before writing a new skill, run `npx skills find <query>` and it searches all indexed marketplaces, ranks results by install count + source reputation + GitHub stars, and prints the top matches with install commands. Official sources (Vercel, Anthropic) are weighted higher. Prevents skill sprawl and duplicate effort. MIT.
install: npx skills add vercel-labs/skills --skill find-skills --agent claude-code

name: claude-video
hook: 19.8k stars (+1.8k last 30 days). Adds a `/watch` slash command to Claude Code: paste any video URL and the plugin downloads it via yt-dlp, extracts key frames, deduplicates visually similar ones, runs Whisper transcription when captions are absent, and passes the full frame + transcript context to Claude. Practical for reviewing UI recordings, conference talks, and tutorial videos from inside a session. MIT. Requires yt-dlp and ffmpeg.
